method: Hand-written single-best-answer MCQs grounded only in the accepted open full text.

topic.topicDisplayName: Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy and Adhesive Capsulitis
topic.coverageNote: One review covers both named conditions. It does not give operative indications.

mcqs.question: What does this review call the cornerstone of care for rotator cuff-related shoulder pain?

options.A: Structured rehabilitation with scapular stabilization, motor control, and progressive cuff and periscapular strengthening
options.B: Immediate subacromial decompression for every partial tear
options.C: Repeated subacromial corticosteroid injections as sole treatment

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Structured rehabilitation with scapular stabilization, motor control, and progressive cuff and periscapular strengthening
mcqs.explanation: Structured rehabilitation emphasizing scapular stabilization, motor control, and progressive rotator cuff and periscapular strengthening is the cornerstone of care.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Structured rehabilitation emphasizing scapular stabilization, motor control, and progressive rotator cuff/periscapular strengthening is the cornerstone of care

mcqs.question: How does the review describe subacromial corticosteroid injection for rotator cuff-related pain?

options.A: Short-term relief that can facilitate rehabilitation, with waning benefit and a concern that repeated doses may impair tendon biology
options.B: A disease-modifying injection that heals the tendon
options.E: Contraindicated because it has no analgesic effect

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Short-term relief that can facilitate rehabilitation, with waning benefit and a concern that repeated doses may impair tendon biology
mcqs.explanation: Subacromial corticosteroid injection provides short-term relief, measured in weeks, that can facilitate rehabilitation, but benefits wane and repeated dosing may impair tendon biology.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Subacromial corticosteroid injection provides short-term relief (weeks) that can facilitate rehabilitation, but benefits wane, and repeated dosing may impair tendon biology

mcqs.question: What natural history does the review give for adhesive capsulitis?

options.A: Typically self-limited but prolonged, across freezing, frozen, and thawing phases, with lasting limitation in a subset
options.B: A rapidly destructive arthritis that requires replacement within months
options.C: Identical to rotator cuff tendinopathy and treated only with subacromial injection
options.E: A self-limited illness that resolves within a week

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Typically self-limited but prolonged, across freezing, frozen, and thawing phases, with lasting limitation in a subset
mcqs.explanation: Adhesive capsulitis is typically self-limited but prolonged across freezing-frozen-thawing phases, and a subset may have lasting limitations.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Typically self-limited but prolonged across freezing-frozen-thawing phases; a subset may have lasting limitations

mcqs.question: Which injection strategy does the review say improves short-term pain and function in adhesive capsulitis, especially when paired with therapy?

options.A: Intra-articular corticosteroid, particularly when given early
options.C: Intravenous corticosteroid as the only effective route
options.D: No injection has any short-term effect
options.E: Platelet-rich plasma is required before any steroid

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Intra-articular corticosteroid, particularly when given early
mcqs.explanation: Intra-articular corticosteroid, especially early, improves short-term pain and function and is most effective when paired with therapy.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Intra-articular corticosteroid injection, especially early, improves short-term pain and function and is most effective when paired with therapy

mcqs.question: How does hydrodilatation compare with steroid alone in the analyses this review cites?

options.A: It offers superior short-term range-of-motion and pain gains versus steroid alone in several analyses
options.B: It is inferior to steroid alone for both pain and motion
options.C: It is used only for rotator cuff calcific tendinopathy
options.E: The review advises against it because it worsens the freezing phase

mcqs.correctAnswerText: It offers superior short-term range-of-motion and pain gains versus steroid alone in several analyses
mcqs.explanation: Hydrodilatation (capsular distension) offers superior short-term range-of-motion and pain gains versus steroid alone in several analyses.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Hydrodilatation (capsular distension) offers a superior short-term range of motion (ROM)/pain gains versus steroid alone in several analyses
